days.file: Altobello Melone - The Road to Emmaus - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Road to Emmaus
days.alt: The risen Christ, unrecognised, walks as a pilgrim with hat and staff beside two disciples on a country road.
days.look: Look again at the three travellers walking shoulder to shoulder along the road. What if he is nearer to you than you can tell?
days.license: Artist died c. 1543; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Ignaz Raab - Hagar and Ishmael with the Angel in the Wilderness - O 12684 - National Gallery Prague.jpg
days.title: Hagar and Ishmael with the Angel in the Wilderness
days.alt: Hagar, in a red cloak and holding an empty water jar, looks up at an angel who reaches toward her from the clouds above a dim wilderness.
days.look: Look again at Hagar's face turned up to the angel. What tender word might God be speaking to you in your own wilderness?
days.license: Artist died 1787; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary
days.alt: Jesus sits on a garden terrace, speaking quietly, while Mary sits at his feet listening.
days.look: Look again at Mary, sitting close at his feet with nothing to do. Could you simply stay beside him for a few minutes today?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Institution of the Eucharist
days.alt: Christ, holding a paten, places the Host on the lips of an apostle at the long table while the others wait with hands joined.
days.look: Look again at the Host Christ gives to his apostle, who receives it with hands on his heart. Can you trust that he is just as truly there when you feel nothing?
days.license: Artist died 1455; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - The Good Shepherd (Le bon pasteur) - James Tissot - overall.jpg
days.title: The Good Shepherd
days.alt: A shepherd in a white head-cloth climbs a steep rocky slope, carrying a sheep across his shoulders.
days.look: Look again at the sheep across the shepherd's shoulders, carried over steep rock. What could make him let go?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Incredulity of Saint Thomas
days.alt: Thomas reaches toward the wound in the side of the risen Christ, who stands among the apostles with one hand raised.
days.look: Look again at Thomas's hand reaching toward Christ's side. What would you say to him about the things you cannot see?
days.license: Artist died c. 1318; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Adam Elsheimer - Die Flucht nach Ägypten (Alte Pinakothek).jpg
days.title: The Flight into Egypt
days.alt: By moonlight, Joseph holds a small torch toward the child as Mary rides the donkey along a dark shore.
days.look: Look again at the small light Joseph carries through the dark. Whose word would you trust for just the next step?
days.license: Artist died 1610; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: The Sower - painting by Van Gogh.jpg
days.title: The Sower
days.alt: A farmer in a blue coat strides across a ploughed field, scattering seed, with a huge yellow sun low over the wheat behind him.
days.look: Look again at the sower's open hand, scattering seed into the ploughed earth. What might God be growing in you that you cannot see?
days.license: Artist died 1890; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Le Roi David jouant de la harpe, par Le Dominiquin.jpg
days.title: King David Playing the Harp
days.alt: King David in a rose-coloured robe lifts his face toward heaven as he plays a tall harp, with two small angels beside him.
days.look: Look again at David's face lifted toward heaven as he plays. Even now, what one small thing can you thank God for?
days.license: Artist died 1641; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
